title: Sound Safe Wrappers
goal: Encapsulate unsafe raw pointer lookup within a sound safe wrapper using minimal unsafe blocks.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unsafe Rust

hints: Calling as_ptr() on a slice is safe.
Ensure strict bounds checking (`index < slice.len()`) before entering unsafe pointer arithmetic.
explanation: To make an unsafe abstraction safe, you must perform proper bounds checking (`index < slice.len()`) before pointer arithmetic. `index <= slice.len()` is an off-by-one bug that permits reading past the end of the slice when `index == slice.len()`.
